citation: Fergason, R.L., et al. (2020) Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM mosaic, USGS Astrogeology. doi:10.5066/P9REJ9JN
encoding: uint16 little-endian, elevation_m = value/10 - 3000, 0 = no data, row-major north to south
projection: Equirectangular, Mars 2000 sphere R=3396190 m, lat_ts=0, lon_0=0 (projected metres; east-west ground spacing = postM*cos(lat))
